citations.description: show_ticket(373f-8c1d-cef0-41bf): comments field is [] (empty array) — no net-total comment posted to parent ticket

9ce8 comment: 'net -3 src comment lines in reconciler subtree'; 4fc1 comment: 'net 34 src lines across 25 files'; 4b94 comment: 'net 46 comment/docstring lines'; ad16 comment: 'conservative-correct shard, executor.py 791->790'; da4c comment: 'net comment reduction in code = 31 code-comment lines removed vs ~20 added'; ab77 comment: '10 comment lines removed / 14 added' — all on shard tickets, not on parent

findings.criterion: Each shard MEASURES and RECORDS on its own ticket the actual comment lines it recovered (by diff line-count), and this parent records the net total across shards.
findings.detail: Each of the six shard tickets does record its own measured recovery (9ce8: net -3 lines; 4fc1: net 34 lines; 4b94: net 46 lines; ad16: executor.py 791→790; da4c: ~31 removed/~20 added; ab77: ~10 removed/~14 added). However, the parent ticket 373f-8c1d-cef0-41bf has an empty comments array — no comment recording the net total across all shards has been posted to this parent ticket, as the AC explicitly requires ('this parent records the net total across shards').
findings.remediation: Post a comment on ticket 373f-8c1d-cef0-41bf recording the net total comment lines recovered across all six shards (sum of the per-shard measured figures from each shard's completion comment).

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: use the evidence path that matches each one. For codebase-verifiable work, complete any unfinished work and make its proof discoverable in the repository. For evidence that inherently lives outside the repository, mark the criterion with the exact `[operator-attested]` tag and add a comment to this ticket that documents the concrete artifacts that meet it (commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the evidence to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so properly tagged evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. An untagged external criterion cannot be satisfied by a ticket comment alone. Then re-verify.
